inputs.question: What is included in the anal cancer treatment package?

outputs.answer:
ITC offers two program options for the Alternative Anal Cancer Treatment package, each with different inclusions. The Out-Patient program ($18,995 USD) includes weekly comprehensive lab work, prescribed imaging, core alternative treatments, two health-focused meals daily, standard medications, and a 3-month post-discharge follow-up. The In-Patient program ($30,000 USD) includes 24/7 medical supervision, full room and board with private accommodations and three daily meals, extensive weekly diagnostics, diagnostic imaging, full access to clinical therapies, pharmacy support for protocol-specific medications, and a 3-month follow-up consultation.
